rationale: The agent executed an exchange without first authenticating the user in the conversation, did not present or confirm ownership of the order visibly, and most critically, performed an order-changing write (submitted the thermostat exchange) without explicit user confirmation, which violates the stated policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The user’s request also included a conditional keyboard exchange; the agent neither confirmed that no suitable clicky, RGB, full-size keyboard existed nor presented options or evidence from product lookups before proceeding. While the final message contains specific outcomes (thermostat exchange and refund), these details are not supported by visible tool results and came after an unconfirmed write. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
